comments.author: cybersol
comments.story: The blind mind: No sensory visual imagery in aphantasia
comments.why: Describes aphantasia and includes a test
comments.text: So I have aphantasia, and I first realized when talking to someone about mental images and memories. They have photorealistic pictures in their mind, or even video scenes like a movie. At my best I have something like an expressionist painting with words and concepts arranged spatially on blobs of color representing the object. More typically, just blackness. Here is another description of it, and a test in the first part: [VIDEO]

comments.author: frabcus
comments.why: Artist with aphantasia explains her drawing workflow
comments.text: It's hard! There are some professional artists who are aphantasic, e.g. this YouTube video talks about it [VIDEO] IIRC, the artist does lots of sketches, and looks at them to see what looks right. And also uses computer models to get angles of what she's drawing which she struggles with otherwise.
